title: Hangi Süper Kahraman Olsam?
author: Doğan Akdoğan
description: When getting out of their pyjamas feels like a job for a superhero, siblings Do and Di start dreaming up powers of their own. Ice Cream Girl has a cone on every finger, Super Shoelace swoops in to tie undone laces, and the Lost Toy Wizards can squeeze under any bed to rescue missing treasures. The game gets sillier with every new hero, until their mother sends them to the mirror to see who might have the powers they’re looking for. With playful sibling banter and a superhero game young readers can make their own, this picture book celebrates imagination, resourcefulness, and the confidence to tackle everyday challenges.
